prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1408; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in Katy, Texas, and reported that Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side while Driver 1 was completing a left turn. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain. The injury pattern is consistent with the force and direction of this impact. Vehicle damage on both cars matches the described collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several details of the account, but no independent witnesses were located. Driver 2 and the Passenger both stated that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of the crash, and the responding officer observed Driver 1 at the scene. Some minor scratches on Driver 1's vehicle appeared older than the current damage, and the reporting officer noted that they may predate this collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene. Further follow-up is pending.
